annotations.title: Cruise Fare Index: are cruise prices rising or falling?

description: Fantasize's Cruise Fare Index: how the price of the same cruises moves night to night, from our own nightly pricing of every sailing (each sailing compared only with its own earlier price, so new sailings and sell-outs never move it). Returns the overall level and its change, and the same by cruise company (with stock ticker), cruise line, region and months to departure, plus the cruise companies' latest press releases. Name a group (e.g. "Royal Caribbean Group", "Alaska", "3-6 months out") for its daily series.

days.description: How many days of the series

group.description: A series name for its daily points, e.g. "Carnival Corp", "Celebrity", "Caribbean"
